description: Stable proto ScoreService (GetScore) consumed by the test-genie report supplement (2s budget, silent skip) and discoverable via cli-health/ui-health manifests.

requirements.description: A stable proto service ScoreService with at minimum a GetScore unary RPC must be defined under packages/proto/schemas/scenario-completeness-scoring/v1. The GetScore request must accept a scenario identifier and return the full score payload (composite score, rung, breakdown, freshness block, recommendations, optional importance line). The service must be consumed by test-genie's report supplement with a 2-second budget and silent skip on failure. The service endpoint must be registered in and discoverable via cli-health and ui-health manifests. The proto contract must remain backward-compatible across minor versions.
requirements.title: Stable ScoreService Proto Contract with GetScore RPC and Service Discovery Registration
